subject: Pilot sequencing: MAP, evaluation cadence and contract sequencing (MSA / DPA / Order Form)
messages:
From: James Sullivan <j.sullivan@medalign.com>
To: david_kim@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@medalign.com
Date: Tue, 15 Apr 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Aligning on evaluation cadence + contracting sequence for pilot

David —

Thanks again for the product demo yesterday. To move our internal review forward we need a simple mutual action plan (MAP) that ties the 30-day pilot evaluation cadence to contracting milestones (MSA/DPA/order form). Procurement has a hard target of signing by end of Q2 for budget reasons, but legal needs a clear sequencing callout to plan review slots.

High level asks from our side:
- A MAP that lists milestone owners and realistic lead times for legal review (MSA and DPA) and finalizing the order form.
- A note on whether the DPA can be reviewed in parallel with MSA redlines or if you require the MSA to land first.
- A list of evidence artifacts (SOC2 report, KMS/HSM details) we should expect to receive and when.

I attached our updated RFP (MedAlign_RFP_v2.pdf) — procurement added a couple of contract constraints around data residency and logging. Happy to share a calendar with our legal and procurement team once we have a proposed MAP.

Can you share a draft by EOD tomorrow? That will help us set two legal review windows next week.

Best,
James Sullivan
Director, Vendor Programs
MedAlign Health

---
Attachment: MedAlign_RFP_v2.pdf (application/pdf)
From: david_kim@redwood.com
To: James Sullivan <j.sullivan@medalign.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 15 Apr 2025 13:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Aligning on evaluation cadence + contracting sequence for pilot

James —

Thanks, and appreciate the clear ask. I put together a compact, operational MAP that uses a "staircase" approach (short pilot milestone windows that gate subsequent contract activities). Key assumptions: we run the 30-day pilot in your US region, you will share SOC2 evidence and a KMS integration spec within the first 5 business days, and procurement wants the order form locked at signature (no post-sign pricing changes).

Summary (draft MAP highlights):
1) Pilot kickoff (Day 0) — tech onboarding + test data ingest (Redwood owner: marissa_cole)
   - Deliverables: onboarding checklist, prefix/KV cache plan, test dataset manifest
   - Attach: Redwood onboarding checklist (we'll attach after your confirmation)

2) Pilot cadence (Days 1–30) — evaluation sprints, weekly check-ins
   - Acceptance gate (Day 30): functional acceptance sign-off by your engineering lead
   - If acceptance passes, proceed to commercial close lane; if not, 14-day remediation window

3) Parallel legal cadence (recommended): start DPA review immediately on Day 3 (legal redline window: 5 business days) while MSA follows (MSA redline window: 7 business days).
   - Rationale: DPA is typically narrower and will unblock procurement; running in parallel shortens calendar risk. If your legal insists on MSA-first, we will sequence MSA then DPA but that adds ~7–10 business days.

4) Order form finalization (post-acceptance): procurement to confirm PO terms; Redwood issues final order form for signature within 2 business days after commercial sign-off.

Dependencies & risks:
- SOC2 report or evidence must be available early (Day 3–5) to satisfy compliance review; otherwise procurement will schedule an extra evidence window.
- Any non-standard data residency or HSM requirements will need an SOW addendum (adds ~5 business days).

Proposed next steps:
- We attach a draft MAP workbook (Redwood_MAP_draft.xlsx) — please review and mark owners/target dates.
- If that looks reasonable I can book two legal windows next Wed/Thu (we have a 10:30am PT slot open).

We can also add an "acceptance stair-step" in the MAP to gate partial commercial payment upon early functional milestones if that helps procurement spread risk.

I'll await confirmation on whether to start DPA in parallel.

Thanks,
David Kim
Head of Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

---

David —

Appreciate the clear staircase approach. A few clarifying Qs before we mark owners in the workbook:
1) SOC2: we can provide our last SOC2 Type II summary and the audit contact (we need your SOC2 or equivalent). Is that in the evidence bucket you referenced?
2) KMS/HSM: the RFP requires us to validate key management options. Can you share a short tech spec or SOW wording we can pass to our security team?
3) DPA parallel review: procurement supports parallel review but legal wants to preserve an option to surface vendor-standard MSA clauses before final DPA acceptance — is that workable?

Procurement tossed a proposed calendar (see attachment). Our preferred end-of-signature target is 2025-06-30 but we can be flexible with an agreed buffer.

If you can confirm the SOC2 evidence location and attach a short KMS spec we can confirm legal windows and I will populate the calendar with our internal owners.

Thanks —
James
